method: Post-freeze source-aware implementation-agent audit of all active answers and inactive dependencies against the original local dossier, current registry capture and official Cochrane 2019 elaborations. Not independently blinded or clinically adjudicated.
scope: Integrated development case; not accuracy/concordance, isolated superiority, or unique gold labels.
overall_basis: D3 High alone drives High through overall.any_high under rob2-kit.overall.cochrane-conditional.v1. ADR0039 requires qualified, result-specific confidence assessment for cumulative concerns; the historical count policy is verification-only.

source_pages: Article PDF3: independent pharmacist, random blocks, concealed preparation
findings: PY sequence follows more than a randomized label while preserving unreported generation details.
Code storage envelope is not misclassified as proof of a sequential-envelope allocation method.
Baseline comparison does not pretend to include the two excluded randomized placebo participants.
limits: Not a randomized-label-only or minimization mechanism control.

source_pages: Article PDF3/8: indistinguishable injections, masked investigators, end-of-participation guesses
Article PDF4/5: assigned groups, analyzed66/randomized68, refusal/no diaries
findings: Distinguishes missing-outcome modified ITT from adherence-based as-treated exclusion. Secondary as-treated analysis is not substituted for primary result.
No diaries is documented for one exclusion; absence of post-baseline outcome data for pre-treatment refusal is inferred and retained as unknown.
Later noncompleters remain analyzed; missingness is assessed separately in D3.
limits: PY appropriate-analysis depends on a plausible missing-only inference for the refusal, not proof that no recorded outcomes were discarded.

domains.assessment: Strongest source-grounded finding; defensible risk judgment, not proof of realized bias
source_pages: Article PDF4 flow visually delivered: study discontinuations distinct from treatment nonreceipt
Appendix PDF10: three worsening-pain placebo participants stopped prematurely
Appendix PDF13/14: actual primary imputation comparisons
Appendix PDF15:131/1650 missing weekly records, later/placebo-heavy, asserted MAR
findings: Does not equate ITT/LOCF with complete observed outcomes or7.9% records with participant availability.
Acknowledges estimates remain negative across actual alternatives; post-hoc timing does not disqualify D3 reassurance.
Critically appraises whether conditioning/assumptions cover efficacy-related dropout. No baseline association does not rule out dependence on unobserved pain.
Does not demand a named MNAR method or claim exact undocumented method failure.

Actual missingness/dropout linkage and lack-of-efficacy reasons support likely rather than merely possible outcome dependence; imputed worsening table is not treated as proof of unobserved future values.
limits: Full imputation conditioning is unavailable; appropriate conditioning on observed histories could mitigate some missingness.
Exact magnitude/direction of resulting bias is unknown. High is defensible, not uniquely certified by this audit.
The real case contains described dropout mechanisms; it does not isolate the newly removed documentation prerequisite.

domains.assessment: Defensible probable maintained masking; participant awareness remains uncertain
source_pages: Article PDF3: participant diary pain assessor and common procedures
Article PDF8:13/34 active correctly guessed;15/34 active guessed placebo;17/32 placebo guessed placebo; guesses based on perceived response
Article PDF10: acknowledged potential skin-based unmasking; none reported recognition by skin

findings: Correctly identifies participant as assessor for pain. Does not use independent observer masking to erase participant awareness.
Does not equate subjectivity with invalid measurement or greater missingness with different measurement methods.

Guesses and possible cosmetic mechanism do not automatically prove knowledge during ratings; substantial incorrect/unknown guesses and no recognized treatment-specific signs support PN with timing uncertainty.
limits: Participant beliefs could still affect ratings; timing/certainty not documented. PN is not proof of perfect masking.
Questions4.4/4.5 are inactive, so revised unlikely-influence anchor is not directly behaviorally tested.
Appendix16 photos are post-study illustration, not trial masking certification; not retrospectively credited to the model.

domains.assessment: Defensible cautious judgment; exact NI answers remain reviewable

Appendix PDF13/14: disclosed post-hoc imputation alternatives
Current NCT01251211: broadly matching diary endpoint, repeat-dose discrepancy, posting/update dates
findings: Does not backdate current endpoint content to first registry posting or interpret dosing difference as proven result-driven amendment.
Prespecified-primary wording is retained as positive evidence, not silently dismissed.
Multiplicity/post-hoc status alone is not called results-driven selection.
Lack of historical detailed intentions alongside potential eligible alternatives supports uncertainty.
limits: Dated historic plan and amendment reasons remain unavailable.
Published primary status and joint reporting could support more reassuring5.2/5.3 inferences; complete independently documented eligibility is not a general production prerequisite.
NI answers are conservative and should receive independent expert review; domain SomeConcerns is defensible from unresolved5.1 without certifying each NI as uniquely correct.

behavioral_successes: Exact original endpoint preserved; narrower reported population not substituted for target.
Critical rather than automatic sensitivity-method reassurance.
remaining_validation: Independent clinical/source-aware adjudication, particularly D2 inference and D5 NI alternatives.
Prospective positive/negative model cases for randomized-label-only/minimization and nonjudgment mortality exception, if separately authorized.
Matched comparator needed before any attribution or gain claim.
